scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.render:build: npm ci --prefix server --omit=dev && npm ci --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.render:start: npm run seed --prefix server && npm run seed:audit --prefix server && npm start --prefix server
